objective: Collect reproducible self-play outcomes for estimating bidder-team points conditional on the bidder's canonical first-four-card key.
non_goals: Learn or replace the trump-selection heuristic
Persist UI or WebSocket self-play traces by default

population.catalog_order: canonical-key compact JSON in ascending UTF-8 lexical order

sampling.physical_hand_selection: Uniform over all physical four-card hands that map to the requested canonical key.
sampling.remaining_deck_selection: Uniform Fisher-Yates shuffle of the other 28 cards, followed by the normal first-four/rest-four seat allocation.

rng.algorithm: CPython random.Random MT19937 with randbelow-based choice and shuffle
rng.seed_derivation: deal_id interpreted as an unsigned integer; named substreams use length-prefixed SHA-256(deal_seed, stream_name, stream_index)
rng.root_seed: Set once in the production run manifest
rng.bot_randomness: Derive independent deterministic streams from deal_id, decision_index and rollout_index

identity.hash_composition: Each variable-length identity component is prefixed by its unsigned 8-byte big-endian UTF-8 length before SHA-256 hashing.

game.target_role: forced final bidder for data-generation play samples

trump_selection.optimization_scope: frozen heuristic; not a learned target in this experiment

required_rules: An opening bidder with zero first-four card points always chooses redeal.
A full deal aborts if one player holds all four Jacks.
A full deal aborts if the bidder's team holds all eight cards of the selected trump suit.

opening_zero_point.storage: Store one deterministic row per requested sample slot so shard accounting remains exact; these rows are rule classifications, not played samples.

later_position_zero_point.condition: bid_position in [2, 3, 4] and sum(first-four card points) == 0
later_position_zero_point.rationale: The family redeal rule applies only to the opening bidder; later positions remain distinct conditional strata.

full_deal_abort.behavior: Record attempt count and reasons, then resample the remaining 28 cards deterministically until the sample slot completes.

target_first4_all_jacks.condition: The target first four cards are the four Jacks.
target_first4_all_jacks.simulation: Do not retry the remaining deck because every completion still leaves all four Jacks in one hand.
target_first4_all_jacks.storage: Store one deterministic row per requested sample slot for exact reconciliation; do not run gameplay.

search.selection_rule: Use baseline if its 100-game stratified GCP pilot has p95 game simulation time <= 30 seconds and acceptable correctness/reliability. Otherwise compare Option A on the identical deal IDs. Do not reduce rollouts automatically.

performance.timed_region: Headless simulation only; exclude container startup, persistence and orchestration.

execution.production_layout: Four indexed 25-sample tasks per canonical key (9,048 tasks total); CLOUD_RUN_TASK_INDEX deterministically selects key and sample range.
execution.stop_flag_check: Before starting each sample slot and after persisting each result.

persistence.progress_control_store: Firestore only if needed for the shared stop/progress document
persistence.write_contract: Write an immutable task shard to a temporary object, verify it, then publish under a deterministic object name. BigQuery ingestion deduplicates by result_id.

budget.enforcement: Launch bounded waves; at the operational stop set STOP_REQUESTED and cancel the active Cloud Run Job execution. Billing-budget notifications alone are not treated as a hard real-time cap.

phase_gates.phase_3: Focused correctness, determinism, Rust enforcement and idempotence tests pass.
phase_gates.phase_4: Dedicated guarded GCP project provisioned with user-controlled authentication.
phase_gates.phase_5: One Rust-backed GCP sample completes and persists correctly.
phase_gates.phase_6: Production K policy selected from paired pilots.
phase_gates.phase_7: Representative full-key rehearsal passes reconciliation and stop-control tests.
phase_gates.phase_8: Production collection reconciled and frozen for analysis.
